breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
services.intro: Codraft is a studio that plans, builds and looks after websites, software and AI tools for businesses that want to understand what they get.
services.index.label: Stages on this page
services.index.plan: Free audit and a fixed offer
plan.body: We begin with a free audit of your current website and Google visibility. You then get a fixed scope, timeline and price before any work starts.
services.plan.audit.body: We review your website and how customers find you on Google, or, if you don’t have a site yet, just your visibility on Google.
services.plan.audit.gets.1: A check of speed, how the site works on mobile, your Google Business Profile, accessibility and visibility in AI search.
services.plan.audit.gets.2: A 30-minute call about what we found.
services.plan.audit.gets.3: A written summary with priorities, with no obligation.
services.plan.scope.body: Before any work starts, you get a written offer. The price doesn’t change unless the scope does.
services.plan.scope.gets.1: Scope: exactly what we do, and what isn’t included.
services.plan.scope.gets.2: Timeline: when each part is done and when the site goes live.
services.plan.scope.gets.3: Price: a fixed amount for the agreed scope.
build.websites.body: Fast, mobile-first sites and online stores built to turn visitors into calls, bookings and orders.
build.websites.gets.1: A design made for mobile first, with a clear path to a call, a booking or an order.
build.websites.gets.2: Speed measured before launch, on mobile and on desktop.
build.websites.gets.3: Basic SEO from day one: titles, descriptions, structured data and a sitemap for Google.
build.websites.gets.4: For an online store: products, a basket, payment and order confirmation by email.
build.apps.body: Custom portals, dashboards and admin tools that replace spreadsheets and manual workarounds.
build.apps.gets.1: First, a look at how you work now and where time is lost.
build.apps.gets.2: A tool made for your work: data entry, overviews, reports and access by role.
build.apps.gets.3: Your data moved over from your existing spreadsheets.
build.apps.gets.4: It runs in the browser, on desktop and mobile, with nothing to install.
build.integrations.body: Your website connected to calendars, payments and your CRM, so every enquiry reaches the right person.
build.integrations.gets.1: Online booking connected to your calendar, with confirmation by email.
build.integrations.gets.3: Form enquiries that go straight to your CRM or inbox, to the right person.
build.ai.body: Chatbots, clearly labelled as AI, that answer customers around the clock using your own content, plus automations that take repetitive tasks off your plate.
build.ai.gets.1: A chatbot that answers only from your content: your site, price list and guides.
build.ai.gets.2: When it doesn’t know the answer, it says so and passes the question to you.
build.ai.gets.3: Automations for repetitive tasks, such as sorting enquiries and moving data between tools.
build.ai.gets.4: A log of the conversations, so you can see what customers ask most.
run.hosting.body: Managed hosting, updates, backups and security patches, all for a fixed monthly fee.
run.hosting.gets.1: Hosting with HTTPS, on a server in the EU.
run.hosting.gets.3: Daily backups, and your site restored if something goes wrong.
run.hosting.gets.4: Uptime monitoring and small content changes.
run.seo.body: Ongoing work on your search rankings, Google Business Profile and reviews, plus how you show up in AI search tools.
run.seo.gets.1: Your Google Business Profile set up and kept up to date.
run.seo.gets.2: Technical SEO and content for the searches your customers make.
run.seo.gets.3: How to ask real customers for reviews, and how to reply to them.
run.seo.gets.4: A monthly report: Google rankings, visits and enquiries.
run.analytics.body: Analytics, cookie consent and accessibility, set up properly to measure results and help you meet EU requirements.
run.analytics.gets.1: Analytics that starts only after the visitor consents.
run.analytics.gets.2: A cookie banner that loads nothing before consent.
run.analytics.gets.3: An accessibility check against WCAG 2.2 AA, and the fixes.
run.analytics.gets.4: An overview of where your visits and enquiries come from.

services.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
services.faq.price.a: You can see a guide starting price next to each service. You get the exact price in a written offer after the free audit, before any work starts.
services.faq.time.a: You can see a typical timeline next to each service; the exact one is in the offer. It runs from the day we have everything we need from you, such as text and photos.
services.faq.existing.q: I already have a website. Do I need a new one?
services.faq.existing.a: Not necessarily. The audit shows what’s worth keeping. If fixing the speed, the mobile layout or the SEO is enough, we’ll tell you before the offer.
services.faq.ownership.q: Who owns the site, the code and the domain?
services.faq.ownership.a: You do. The code, the domain and every login belong to you, even if one day you go elsewhere. We register the domain in your name. Third-party licences, such as fonts and plugins, stay under their own terms.
services.faq.maintenance.q: Do I have to take maintenance?
services.faq.maintenance.a: No. Maintenance is a separate monthly service, with no minimum term, and you can cancel by the end of any month. If you don’t take it, or leave later, you get every login and a copy of your site.
services.faq.editing.q: Can I change the content without you?
services.faq.editing.a: Yes. You change the text, images and products yourself, and we show you how. Bigger changes we make for you.
services.faq.vat.a: The prices on this page exclude VAT. If we charge VAT, the offer and the invoice show it separately.
services.closing.title: Not sure where to start?
services.closing.lead: Tell us about your business and what you need, and we’ll suggest the first step.
services.closing.note: We reply within one working day.
